content.short: A fresh look at pool performances for Cardano delegators.
content.description:
We take a fresh, uncomplicated look at pool performances and metrics, helping delegators to filter down to the pools they are interested in. Stake addresses can also be monitored for rewards, and a full history for each stake address can be downloaded. Various pool metrics can be downloaded as spreadsheets for deeper analysis.

Built as a progressive web application, ideal for mobile and desktop environments, the site can be added to the home screen on mobile devices for a native app experience. Enjoy!
